component.name: Pokémon Sanctuary
component.summary: Interactive pixel-art Pokémon companions for Wayland desktops

description.p: qs-vpets brings autonomous pixel-art Pokémon companions onto any Wayland desktop supporting wlr-layer-shell (including KDE Plasma Wayland / SteamOS Desktop Mode, Hyprland, Sway, Niri, Cosmic, River, Wayfire, and Labwc).
Companions develop distinct personalities, memories, and inter-Pokémon social bonds over days of use, while rotating emergently between your desktop and the floating Pokémon Sanctuary pasture window.
